caption: The drawing features a single bottle set against a plain, off-white background with a thin rectangular border framing the image. The bottle has a cylindrical shape with sloping shoulders and a short neck sealed with a dark-colored, likely maroon or brown, stopper. The neck of the bottle is golden brown and plain, transitioning into the main body, which is decorated with a dense floral pattern. The floral decoration consists of large blue flowers, likely asters or chrysanthemums, accompanied by green leaves, some smaller red and orange buds, and additional leafy details, all set against a dark, possibly black background. The base of the bottle's neck is a lighter golden color, while the pattern covers the full body of the vessel. The artist’s signature “J. Howard Iams” and the date “1937” appear in the lower right corner just outside the border. There are no other objects depicted in the composition.
title: Decorated Bottle
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
